title: Practice 9: Setting out: пойти, поехать — and сходить, съездить

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Ан не ___ (погнать — to drive off, chase)!
exercises.why: The future perfective (пойду, пойдёшь) belongs to the 1st -ё- type of conjugation. The future perfective (поеду, поедешь) belongs to the 1st -е- type of conjugation. — DLI, Lesson 54.  ·  From Александр Куприн, «Юнкера».
exercises.context: The future perfective (пойду, пойдёшь) belongs to the 1st -ё- type of conjugation.

exercises.q: На Марс сейчас ___ (полететь — to fly off).
exercises.why: The future perfective (полечу, полетишь) belongs to the 2nd (-и-) type of conjugation. — DLI, Lesson 55.  ·  From Алексей Н. Толстой, «Аэлита».
exercises.context: The future perfective (полечу, полетишь) belongs to the 2nd (-и-) type of conjugation.

exercises.q: ___ (побежать — to start running) мы назад.
exercises.why: The past perfective (полетел, -ла, -ло, -ли) is formed in a regular way. — DLI, Lesson 55.  ·  From Аркадий Гайдар, «Дальние страны».
exercises.context: The past perfective (полетел, -ла, -ло, -ли) is formed in a regular way.

exercises.context: The past perfective (полетел, -ла, -ло, -ли) is formed in a regular way.

exercises.q: А ты ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot))?
exercises.why: The perfective verbs пойти and поехать denote a single action with emphasis on the completed start. (Similar to the English concept of "to leave for"; "to set out"). *Где старшина? Он пошёл в штаб.* — DLI, Lesson 54.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Лишние люди».
exercises.context: The perfective verbs пойти and поехать denote a single action with emphasis on the completed start.
